answer: The inlet schedule is applied in spiral and signal makes public each instalment. An farming party thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 839 identities would post 3349 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
